text:
Mia Chen: Heads-up — AWS marketplace co-announcement scheduled for next Tue. We need a clear driver/CUDA/ROCm pin + hotfix handoff so customers via marketplace don't hit regressions.
Ajay Patel: +1. Are we asking partners to consume a single pinned tuple or allow fallback ranges?
Mia Chen: Prefer single pinned tuple for the announcement (simpler messaging). We should document recommended fallbacks for customers though.
Sophie Park: From product/comms perspective, avoid promising a specific stack beyond the pinned tuple. Can we commit to a fallback policy for 30 days post-launch?
Lucas Rivera: Technical request: need exact package names and versions to bake into the marketplace VM/container. Suggest: nvidia-driver 535.86, cuda 12.2, libcudnn 9.1; ROCm: amdgpu-pro 6.6, rocm 5.6. I'll bench these on our perf harness.
Ashwin Iyer: Note model perf dipped on rocm 5.6 vs 5.4 for long-context in last eval. We should include a performance caveat in the compatibility doc.
Ajay Patel: I'll draft a compatibility matrix + a tiny test harness for partners to validate images.
Emily Zhao: Legal/marketplace checklist: listing copy must say "compatible with pinned stack" and include a rollback contact. No mention of guaranteed perf numbers.
Mia Chen: Action items: 1) Lucas validate tuple on AMI/container. 2) Ajay draft matrix + test harness. 3) Sophie prepare customer-facing language. 4) Emily add rollback/contacts. 5) Ops create hotfix playbook.
Lucas Rivera: On step 1 — running a 24h soak with traffic mix and KV-cache reuse scenario on g5 and c6i for marketplace images. Will post numbers.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline triggered: marketplace-image-smoke -> staging (build-1842436790).
Ajay Patel: Matrix will include: pinned tuple, supported ranges, known regressions, mitigation steps, test commands. Example test snippet:
```
# quick GPU smoke for partners
python -m redwood_infer.smoke --model redwood-7b --batch 4 --seq 1024 --tokens 500
```
Mia Chen: Also add a canary rollout plan for customers on Dedicated vs Hosted. Define traffic% and rollback thresholds.
Sophie Park: Proposed canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with perf/cost/quality gates. If latency p95 increases >20% or rouge rate increases >2% revert.
Lucas Rivera: I'll add runtime automated checks: latency, OOMs, KV cache hit rate. If gates fail, pipeline halts.
Ashwin Iyer: For quality gates, tie to an eval pack (50 prompts) and compare embeddings + LM top-k divergence. I'll provide the pack.
Emily Zhao: Marketplace listing should include alias: marketplace-hotfix@redwood.ai and a private partner SCIM channel for urgent patches.
Ajay Patel: Partner hotfix cadence proposal: 48h turnaround for critical/security, 5 business days for non-critical.
Mia Chen: Agreed. Also set release freeze: no major driver bumps 7 days before announcement.
Lucas Rivera: Driver bumps outside maintenance window require explicit partner sign-off.
Sophie Park: I'll draft announcement language and FAQ re: pinned stacks and rollback.
Mia Chen: I'll send a one-pager to partners with the pinned tuple, canary plan, and contact points.
Ajay Patel: I'll attach the initial compatibility matrix to the one-pager.
deploy-bot: staging build completed: marketplace-image-smoke (1842436812) -> all checks passed.
Lucas Rivera: 24h soak results: no OOMs, p95 latency +8%, KV hit stable. Will run Ashwin's eval pack and post results.
Ashwin Iyer: Eval pack running; expect numbers within 12h.
Emily Zhao: Prepping marketplace legal copy and rollback T&Cs.
Mia Chen: Thanks all — I'll put follow-ups as comments on the one-pager. If partners request broader supported ranges that's a separate compatibility offering. :thumbsup:
